title: DID Management — Account Status — payload
description: An account holder reads its own account on a DID hosting service: its state, and when it would be disabled or purged. The request names nothing: the account is the issuer's own. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Status — response payload
Response.description: The issuer's account. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.
